title: Vivaha Avahanam
overview: Young lovers commit suicide when their parents don’t agree to their marriage. But when the families face big troubles since the tragedy, to change their circumstances, Based on an astrologer's advice, they resort to desperate measure of  marrying souls unhappy souls of both children, which takes more funny and serious turns.
